entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Largest human empire of Sarpadia on Dominaria, destroyed by goblins and orcs.

entities.name: Lady Margaret Ellsworth
entities.description: Prime Minister of Icatia who dwelt in Windenby.

entities.name: Order of Leitbur
entities.description: Icatian clerical sect founded by Bethan Leitbur to worship the Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Bethan Leitbur
entities.description: Founder of the Order of Leitbur.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order opposed by the Order of Leitbur.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Gained vast cult-like followers amid Icatian corruption.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Followers of Oliver Farrel pressing for reform and harder opposition to the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: Corruption among Icatian officials allowed Oliver Farrel to gain vast cult-like followers.
events.quote: Corruption ran rampant among Icatia's many officials, allowing Oliver Farrel to gain vast cult-like followers.

events.summary: Icatia was destroyed by goblins and orcs.
events.quote: Icatia was destroyed by goblins and orcs

relations.note: Oversaw the government on his behalf.
relations.quote: oversaw the Icatian government on behalf of King Henry Joseph
